privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your personal data under GDPR.

s1.title: 1. Data Controller
s1.p1: VOIS AI AS is the data controller responsible for your personal data collected through the Vois application and website.

s2.title: 2. Data We Collect
accountItems: Email address (for account creation and communication)
Payment information (processed by Apple for in-app purchases and Stripe for web purchases; we do not store card details)
usageItems: App usage analytics (anonymized, collected only with your consent via PostHog, EU-hosted)
Device identifiers (anonymous device ID for non-logged-in users)
contentItems: Voice recordings and audio files (processed for transcription)
Transcribed text, notes, and meeting transcripts
Chat messages sent to AI assistants
Calendar events and task content extracted from notes
Images uploaded for text extraction and analysis
AI-generated summaries, tasks, and email drafts

s3.title: 3. AI Training Policy
s3.boxTitle: Your Data is NOT Used for AI Training
s3.boxText: We do NOT use your private voice notes, transcripts, or any personal content to train AI models. Your data remains your property. None of our third-party AI providers — Deepgram, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, or Perplexity — use your data sent through VOIS for model training purposes.
s3.p1: When we process your data through third-party AI services, it is:
items: Sent securely via encrypted API connections to the relevant provider
Processed and returned to you in real time
Not retained by any AI provider for training purposes
Subject to our data processing agreements with each sub-processor
Handled under each provider's commercial API terms, which prohibit training on customer data

s4.title: 4. Local-First Architecture
s4.boxIntro: Vois employs a local-first architecture. This means:
items: Voice recordings are processed and stored securely in your personal cloud database (Supabase).
Audio files are retained to enable playback and reprocessing. You can delete your recordings at any time from within the app.
Your notes and transcripts sync securely to your account but remain encrypted.

s5.title: 5. Third-Party AI Services
s5.boxText: VOIS uses third-party artificial intelligence services to provide core app functionality. You are asked for explicit consent before any personal data is shared with these services. Below is a detailed breakdown of what data each provider receives and why.
s5.dataSentHeading: Data we send to AI services:
dataSentItems: Voice recordings and audio files for transcription
Transcribed text for task extraction, calendar event creation, and summaries
Chat messages for AI assistant responses
Meeting audio and transcripts for live note generation
Images for text extraction and analysis

providers.name: Deepgram, Inc.
providers.purpose: Real-time and recorded speech-to-text transcription, including speaker identification during meetings.

providers.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
providers.dataReceived: Transcribed text, chat messages, images, meeting transcripts, and task content.
providers.purpose: Text analysis, task and event extraction, chat assistant responses, meeting note generation, email drafting, and image analysis.

providers.name: Anthropic, PBC (Claude)
providers.purpose: AI chat assistant responses when Claude is selected as the active model.

providers.name: Google LLC (Gemini)
providers.purpose: AI chat assistant responses when Gemini is selected as the active model.

providers.name: xAI Corp. (Grok)
providers.purpose: AI chat assistant responses when Grok is selected as the active model.

providers.name: Perplexity AI, Inc.
providers.dataReceived: Research queries and related context from notes or tasks.
providers.purpose: Web research and information retrieval when you use the Research feature within the AI agent.

s5.protectionHeading: How we protect your data with these providers:
protectionItems: All data is transmitted securely via encrypted API connections (TLS/SSL).
We use each provider's official commercial API, which means your data is processed under their commercial data processing terms and is not used to train their AI models.
Each provider listed above is contractually or by policy required to provide the same or equal protection of your personal data as described in this Privacy Policy.
s5.choicesText: You are asked for explicit consent before any data is shared with third-party AI services. You may revoke this consent at any time in the app's Settings under "AI Data Sharing." If you decline AI consent, features that rely on third-party AI processing (transcription, chat, meeting notes, task extraction) will be unavailable, but you may continue using other app features.

s6.title: 6. Sub-Processors & Infrastructure
s6.p1: We use the following third-party services to operate Vois:
rows: AI Intelligence (Text Analysis, Chat, Meeting Notes, Image Analysis)
App Store Payments & Sign in with Apple
s6.footnote: All sub-processors and infrastructure providers listed above are contractually required to provide the same or equal protection of your personal data as described in this Privacy Policy.

s7.title: 7. Cookies & Website Tracking
s7.p1: Our website (vois.app) uses the following technologies:
necessaryItems: Your cookie consent preference (stored in localStorage)
s7.necessaryNote: These do not require consent as they are essential for the website to function.
analyticsItems: PostHog — Used for website analytics and session recording. Data is hosted in the EU (Frankfurt). PostHog is only activated after you provide consent via our cookie banner.
Data collected includes: page views, clicks, scroll depth, anonymized session recordings (with all input fields masked), device type, and referral source.
No data is shared with advertisers or used for ad targeting.
s7.cookieSettingsNote: You can change your tracking preferences at any time via the Cookie Settings link in our website footer.

s8.title: 8. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR Article 6)
items: Contract Performance: Processing necessary to provide the Vois service you requested.
Legitimate Interest: Service improvements and security monitoring (with appropriate safeguards).

Consent: Sharing data with third-party AI services (you can revoke AI consent at any time in Settings), website analytics via PostHog (you can manage your cookie preferences at any time via the Cookie Settings link in our footer), and marketing communications (you can withdraw consent at any time).
Legal Obligation: Tax records and compliance with applicable laws.

s9.title: 9. Your Rights (GDPR)
s9.p1: Under the General Data Protection Regulation, you have the right to:
items: Access: Request a copy of your personal data
Rectification: Correct inaccurate personal data
Erasure: Request deletion of your data ("Right to be Forgotten")
Portability: Receive your data in a machine-readable format
Restriction: Limit how we process your data
Objection: Object to processing based on legitimate interests
Withdraw Consent: Withdraw consent at any time
s9.contactNote: To exercise these rights, contact us at hello@tryvois.com. We will respond within 30 days.

s10.title: 10. Data Retention
items: Active accounts: Data retained for the duration of your account
Deleted accounts: Data erased within 30 days of account deletion
Financial records: Retained for 7 years as required by Norwegian law

s11.title: 11. Data Security
s11.p1: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data:
items: TLS/SSL encryption for all data in transit
AES-256 encryption for data at rest
Regular security audits and penetration testing
Employee access controls and training

s12.p2: If you believe your rights have been violated, you have the right to lodge a complaint with:
